newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Dozens arrested in Vietnam for cockfighting.
newsitem.headline: Dozens arrested in Vietnam for cockfighting.

text.p: Ninety-two people were arrested in Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City last weekend for organising illegal cockfights and gambling, the Tuoi Tre newspaper said on Tuesday.
Local officials were not available to comment on the report, which said police seized 24 cocks and 65 notebooks which were being used to record bets after they broke up a cockfight meeting on Sunday.
Among those arrested were several "dangerous criminals" who had been wanted by the police for some time, it said.
Tuoi Tre said tens and even hundreds of people gathered every day at secret venues in Ho Chi Minh City to watch blood and feathers fly and place a bet on the victor.
Gambling, as in many other Asian countries, is hugely popular in Vietnam and has become one of the government's targets in a blitz on so-called "social evils".
